title.narrative: Country Programme for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in the Republic of Moldova 2019-2023

description.narrative: The UNIDO Country Programme (CP) for inclusive and sustainable industrial development (ISID) in the Republic of Moldova 2019-2023 was developed and streamlined following the extensive consultations with the Government of Moldova, key national stakeholders and development partners, based on the national priority areas and identified high-potential industrial sectors. The Ministry of Economy has been acting as a key Government focal point throughout the coordination process. The CP is also aligned with the UN Development Assistance Framework (UNDAF) for the Republic of Moldova 2018-2022 and will be further aligned with the upcoming UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework 2023-2027. The CP aims at leveraging coordinated and scaled-up international development efforts under the following key components: 1) Enhanced industrial competitiveness, market access, innovation and investment promotion; 2) Productive employment for rural communities and entrepreneurship development; 3) Sustainable energy and environmental management. UNIDO also contributed to the formulation of the COVID-19 Socio-Economic Response and Recovery Plan (SERP) for the Republic of Moldova.
